title: Evidence of Fraud in an Influential Study About Procrastination
summary: DataColada researchers present statistical evidence suggesting data fabrication in a widely-cited procrastination study by Fuschia Sirois and others, using digit pattern analysis and data distribution anomalies to support their fraud allegations.
problem_solved: Exposes potential scientific fraud and data fabrication in published psychological research that influenced the field.
why_valuable: Demonstrates how statistical forensics can detect research fraud and maintains integrity in scientific literature by holding researchers accountable.
